login.title: Sign in
login.description: Pick up where you left off.

signup.title: Create your account
signup.description: It takes a minute, and your shortlist is saved to it.
signup.footerLogin: Already have an account? Sign in
signup.nameHint: What we'll call you in the fitting room and in emails.
signup.phoneHint: With the country code. We use it when you send an enquiry.
signup.successBody: Your fitting room is ready. Browse the collection and try pieces on to shortlist them.
signup.confirmEmailBody: We've sent you a link. Open it to start trying pieces on.

forgotPassword.title: Reset your password
forgotPassword.description: Tell us your email and we'll send a link.
forgotPassword.emailHint: The address you signed up with.
forgotPassword.successBody: If that address has an account, a reset link is on its way. It lasts 30 minutes.

resetPassword.title: Reset your password
resetPassword.description: Open the link we emailed you to set a new password.
resetPassword.emptyTitle: Open the link from your email
resetPassword.emptyBody: The reset link carries a one-time code, so it only works from your inbox. Ask for a fresh one if yours has expired.

resetPasswordToken.title: Choose a new password
resetPasswordToken.description: Set it once, and every other device is signed out.
resetPasswordToken.successBody: Sign in with your new password. Every device that was signed in has been signed out.

verifyEmail.title: Confirm your email
verifyEmail.description: Open the link we sent you. It expires in a day.
verifyEmail.sentBody: Open it from your inbox and you can start trying pieces on.
verifyEmail.alreadyBody: This address is already confirmed, so there's nothing to do here.
verifyEmail.signedOutTitle: Sign in to send the link
verifyEmail.signedOutBody: We send the confirmation to the address on your account, so sign in first.

verifyEmailToken.title: Confirm your email
verifyEmailToken.description: One press and this address is confirmed.
verifyEmailToken.successBody: You can try pieces on now. Browse the collection and shortlist what you like.

invite.title: Accept your invitation
invite.description: Set a password to finish setting up your admin account.
invite.nameHint: What the rest of the team will see beside your actions.
invite.createdBody: Your admin account is ready. Head to the console to get started.
invite.deadBody: This invitation is no longer usable. An admin can send a new one to the same address.
invite.previewErrorBody: The connection dropped or the server didn't answer. Reload the page to try again.
